name: 00_Cerebrum
notes: The vault machinery with no corpus: the operating manual, WHY.md, the OKF v0.2 spec, the knowledge-base template, three skills and 36 scripts. Build 9 ports visualize.py and viewer-check.js from the source vault for the first time: the graph derives its corners on a unit circle and its blocks, legend and mark from your own data, and the checker asserts structure rather than one vault's ontology. Unpack it, run python3 _scripts/verify.py, and add a knowledge base from _KB_CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md.
